body.prompt: Generate ONE independent blank game UI offer card sprite, newly illustrated, not a crop of the supplied whole-screen reference. Match the reference's deep dark sapphire BLUE continuation offer card in the lower middle. Flat front orthographic view, horizontal rectangular card with restrained clipped corners, thin antique-gold double border, tiny corner filigree. No large jewels, NO top crest, NO wings, NO large loops or projecting swirls. Surface is opaque dark deep dark sapphire BLUE enamel with subtle painterly worn texture, never bright candy colors. Attached to its bottom center is a substantial dark emerald-green button: button OUTER width 62 percent of card width; button height 44 percent of whole sprite height, aspect about 3:1. This green button must be TALL and deep, not a skinny pill. Green face softly shaded with central subdued highlight, thin gold bevel with clipped polygonal corners. Whole outline aspect 2.35:1. Match these geometry proportions carefully: on 1024x512 canvas outer red/blue body bounds x24..1000,y28..350; green button bounds x195..829,y260..452. Both body and button overlap naturally. Main upper face is empty and unobstructed with space for two lines of text and a small status line; lower green face blank for a large live gem/price or play symbol. NO letters, NO text, NO numbers, NO icons or symbols, NO people, NO scene. Gold is subdued antique warm metal with small precise highlights and engraved edges. True transparent exterior alpha, no shadow haze, no checkerboard. Fully opaque colored interiors. Keep all edges completely visible. Exactly ONE card.
